description: Single-plugin marketplace for auto-model-router — per-prompt model + effort routing for Claude Code (haiku/sonnet/opus by intent classification), parallel wave execution for plan-mode and multi-part prompts, and a goal-anchored usage report (cost saved / correction rate / time-to-results).

plugins.name: auto-model-router
plugins.description: Per-prompt model routing for Claude Code. Classifies each prompt into a tier (trivial/standard/complex/deep/optout) with an independent effort score, auto-delegates to a router-{haiku|sonnet|opus} worker subagent at high confidence (>=0.75), and asks when ambiguous. Plan-mode and multi-part prompts fan out into parallel waves with disjoint-file non-interference. Adds router-fable (manual/override-only) for frontier-stakes steps, an optout tier for clean #noshift signalling, and a continuity flag to keep mid-iteration prompts inline. Goal-anchored: /router-report scores cost saved, user-correction rate, and time-to-results. Bundles UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks, two skills (auto-model-routing, plan-with-models), four worker subagents, three slash commands, an audit + usage-report toolset, and a cc-route CLI wrapper.
